subject: SOC2 packet sent — any blockers on review / offer to fast-track?
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@altosystems.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 packet and next steps (recap from today)

Hi Morgan / Asha —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Priority: Evaluation for a customer-facing inference layer; Alto needs predictable latency for search highlights and embeddings-based reranking.
- Main blockers: security/compliance review (SOC2) and procurement timeline (legal + budget)
- Proposed next steps: I shared the SOC2 packet and an initial security questionnaire for your security team to review. If helpful we can schedule a 30-min technical security review with one of our infra engineers to walk through controls, network diagram, and data handling.

Attachments included in this email: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v3.pdf (PDF) — full SOC 2 packet; Security_Questionnaire_AltoSystems.xlsx — our short-form questionnaire (editable).

Requested from you:
1) Any obvious blockers on SOC2 review or evidence we should prioritize?
2) A rough timeline for your security team (e.g., this week, 2–4 weeks, later)
3) If you want a live walkthrough, I can propose two times next week (Tue/Thu).

If there are internal stakeholders who should be looped in (procurement, legal, security lead), feel free to CC them here.

Thanks — happy to make this as frictionless as possible.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment stubs:
- Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v3.pdf (PDF, 4.2 MB)
- Security_Questionnaire_AltoSystems.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)

Hi Morgan —

Just circling back on the SOC2 packet I sent last week. Wanted to check if there are any blockers on your side or a preferred timeframe for review. If the security questionnaire is easier, I can fill the first pass and mark the items we've already documented.

If it helps move things along, we can: 
- Book a 30-min security review with our infra lead (suggest Tue 11/30 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 12/2 14:00–14:30 PT)
- Provide a short summary of controls that map to the items in your questionnaire (I can get that to you by EOD tomorrow)

No rush — just want to make sure nothing is stuck on our side. If your security lead prefers email-only, tell me and I’ll route the evidence directly.

Best regards,
Karthik

Subject: Re: SOC2 packet and next steps (recap from today) — offer to fast-track 

Hi Morgan / Asha —

Following up on Karthik's note. I’m Marissa (Head of Solutions at Redwood) — looping in to offer a quick option to fast-track your review if timing is tight. We can: 

- Schedule a 25-min exec + security touchpoint (me + our infra lead) to answer procurement/security questions directly; we’ll tailor the session to the items you care about most.
- Provide a prioritized evidence bundle mapping for the shared questionnaire so your reviewers see only what’s needed first.
- If procurement prefers, we can surface a short commercial term sheet to accelerate internal approvals.

Proposed times: Wed 11/25 11:00–11:25 PT or Fri 11/27 09:00–09:25 PT. If neither works, tell us two windows that do and we’ll accommodate. We’ve attached a calendar invite stub (Exec_Call_Invite.ics) for the Wed slot — I’ll only send a real invite after you confirm.

If there are any specific blockers (NDA, network diagrams, subprocessor list), flag them here and we’ll prioritize.

Appreciate the partnership and happy to move at the cadence you need.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
